About the Institute

A European perspective for a changing world.

The EBS European Institute brings together business, law and politics to address Europe’s most pressing economic and strategic challenges. It connects research, teaching, executive education and practice, with a particular focus on strengthening Europe’s stability, innovation capacity and competitiveness.
01

Interdisciplinary thinking

Connecting economic, legal and political perspectives to understand complex European challenges across institutional and sector boundaries.

02

Research with practical impact

Developing insights on competitiveness, deregulation, innovation, security, defence and sustainable economic development that can inform real decisions.

03

Leadership for Europe

Bringing together people from industry, academia and institutions while preparing future leaders to shape Europe responsibly and courageously.

Vision

To serve as a forum for people committed to Europe’s future, identify relevant trends early and translate research and teaching into ideas that strengthen Europe’s economy and strategic capacity.

The Fellow Journal

The Journal extends that mission into a student-led publication platform: Fellows develop concise, evidence-based pieces that make European debates accessible, analytical and useful to decision-makers and the wider EBS community.
